areas.title: Cooking and troubleshooting
questions: Why did my sauce split?
What can replace an ingredient without changing its function?
How do I cook this with different equipment?
areas.gap: Recovery and substitution suggestions require host reasoning and recipe-specific review; no outcome guarantee.

areas.title: Home kitchens
questions: What can I cook with my pantry?
How can I coordinate dinner using one oven?
How do I make a grocery list within my budget?
areas.gap: No live pantry, grocery price or appliance integration.

areas.title: Baking and production
questions: How much preferment flour belongs in hydration?
Why is my dough inconsistent?
How do I schedule proofing and oven loads?
areas.gap: Fermentation times and equipment capacity must be supplied or labeled experimental.

areas.title: Menu creation
questions: Help me create a menu with fewer overlapping ingredients.
Format my menu without emojis or fake food images.
How do I write accurate dish descriptions?
areas.gap: New dish ideas are proposals. Pricing and dietary claims need confirmation before formatting or publishing.

areas.title: Purchasing and receiving
questions: Which supplier pack is cheaper?
My delivery and invoice disagree; what do I record?
Can I accept this supplier substitution?
areas.gap: No order submission, supplier message or inventory posting is performed.

areas.title: Inventory and waste
questions: How do I count stock consistently?
Why does counted stock differ from expected stock?
How do I investigate food waste?
areas.gap: Counts, opening balances and movements must be supplied; no automatic physical counting.

areas.title: Costing and business performance
questions: What does this dish cost per portion?
Are delivery-platform sales profitable?
What sales do I need to cover these costs?
areas.gap: Ingredient margin is not net profit. Missing overhead, tax, labor and fee assumptions remain unresolved.

areas.title: Daily operations and reports
questions: What should I check before opening?
How do I write a shift handover?
Help me prepare a manager closing report.
areas.gap: The host drafts narrative sections. Observations, counts, signatures and completed checks are never generated as facts.

areas.title: Front of house and bar
questions: How should I brief the service team?
How do I handle a guest complaint?
How much dilution belongs in a batched drink?
areas.gap: No guest communication, refund or reservation change is executed; alcohol rules require local sources.

areas.title: People and training
questions: How do I teach a new dishwasher the approved routine?
Make a station competency checklist.
How can I make this brief understandable in another language?
areas.gap: Language and competency require human verification. No fabricated signatures or staffing/legal decisions.

areas.title: Safety, cleaning and equipment
questions: How do I document a food safety incident?
How do I trace a recalled ingredient?
What do I do when equipment breaks or a cleaning check fails?
areas.gap: Confirm jurisdiction, approved safety plan and manufacturer instructions. No invented chemical concentrations or safety clearance.

areas.title: Catering and events
questions: Can we deliver this event with our capacity?
Help me create a catering quotation.
What equipment and settlement records do I need?
areas.gap: No booking, quotation acceptance or purchasing commitment is made.

areas.title: Marketing and growth
questions: What should we promote this month?
Did our campaign improve sales?
How do I plan a truthful content calendar?
areas.gap: Sales association does not prove campaign causation. No automatic social publishing or outreach.

areas.title: Care and institutional kitchens
questions: Does this menu match our approved diet specification?
Which dietary requirements are unresolved?
How do I prepare a Ross Manor paperwork handoff?
areas.gap: These general references do not establish clinical suitability. Supplied facility specifications and authorized review are required; no resident-data transfer is implied.
